guard.note: Ars 'n' Spells 3.3.5 for NeoForge: the cooldown type's supplier: builder(CooldownData::new).serialize(CooldownData.CODEC).build(), without copyOnDeath (the affinity and progression suppliers have it)
registers "affinity" (lambda$static$0), "cooldown" (lambda$static$1, COOLDOWN) and "progression" (lambda$static$2): the wrapped lambda is the cooldown type's
CODEC = unboundedMap(STRING, LONG) of category name -> end tick: the copy NeoForge makes through it is lossless
on respawn and dimension change: every category's end tick (0 when over) to the client, so the client follows the copied cooldowns
a death copies only copyOnDeath types, any other clone every serialized type, each through its copy handler (serialize, then read back)
requires the serializer, then sets copyOnDeath and returns the builder

arsnspells_keep_cooldowns_on_clone.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on AttachmentType$Builder.build() in AttachmentTypes.lambda$static$1 (the cooldown type's supplier), require = 1, allow = 1: the builder is marked copyOnDeath first, so NeoForge's PlayerEvent.Clone copy carries the cooldowns through a death (helper bons.furious.patch.arsnspells_coo49.AnsCooldowns). Forge 1.0.49 hooked ModCapabilityProvider.onPlayerClone (before invalidateCaps) and copied through CooldownData.save / load; the 1.21.1 build keeps the data in NeoForge attachments and has neither
